line_items.description: Black Swift S0 sUAS Platforms: 150 EA @ $18,000 (Period 1), 150 EA @ $18,630 (Period 2), 125 EA @ $19,282 (Period 3), 125 EA @ $19,957 (Period 4), 125 EA @ $20,655 (Period 5)

Mission Days Operational support (30 days × 5 periods @ $2,850/day = $427,500), Operational and Testing Support (6 sessions × 5 periods @ $6,000 = $180,000), Operator/Observer Training (1 session × 5 periods @ $6,000 = $30,000), Instructor Training (1 session × 5 periods @ $600 = $3,000)
Travel for Operational Support (5 periods × $50,000 NTE each)
Operator and Observer Course Development (5 periods × $6,000 = $30,000), Instructor Training Course Development (5 periods × $6,000 = $30,000)
Non-recurring Engineering: Technical Documentation (5 periods × $66,000 NTE), Modeling (5 periods × $66,000 NTE), NHC workflow integration (5 periods × $66,000 NTE). Total: $990,000 NTE
